decisions.reason: Because this organic sliced salami platter is very close to the firm's core charcuterie capabilities and supports its stated expansion of organic lines in a growing market, management would likely retain it despite only modest website prominence.

Because these organic poultry mini salami snacks build directly on the firm's existing meat-processing and seasoning know-how while also fitting its organic and assortment-expansion strategy, management is likely to keep them on the market.

Because this premium salami sharing snack remains close to the firm's established salami expertise and broad-range strategy, management would likely keep it and use early market learning to refine it rather than withdraw it quickly.
